character_tex: $K^{(2M)}_a = \eta(\tau)^{-1}\sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}} q^{(a+2Mj)^2/4M}$, the characters of the $U(1)_{2M}$ lattice algebra; at $R^2 = 2M$ the momentum and winding $(n, w)$ have $h = \frac{(n+wM)^2}{4M}$, $\bar h = \frac{(n-wM)^2}{4M}$.
description: Compact boson at $R^2 = 2$: the even lattice $\sqrt{2}\,\mathbb{Z}$ extends $U(1)$, and $Z$ is diagonal in its characters.
